blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — An estimated P22.187 million worth of property was damaged in two separate fires in Mandaue City on October 7 and 8, according to the Bureau of Fire Protection-Mandaue (BFP-Mandaue). The larger fire broke out at a warehouse in Barangay Subangdaku late Wednesday afternoon, October 7. The fire affected about 1,800 square meters and caused an estimated P21.56 million in damage, based on the office’s investigation report sent to the media.
